methodologyNote: Measured via social media referrals in tracked traffic.

aiSummary: In October 2026, Facebook led social media (mobile) in Australia at 74.87% (market share of tracked page views / usage). Twitter ranked second at 7.5%, followed by Instagram at 7.21%.

faqs.question: Which item leads social media (mobile) in Australia?

faqs.answer: Figures are market share of tracked page views / usage from the cited source for October 2026. They are not invented estimates.
